properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 2 at 12:02AM CDT until October 2 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Shreveport LA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast Oklahoma, including the following
county, McCurtain and northeast Texas, including the following
counties, Camp, Franklin, Morris, Red River, Smith, Titus, Upshur
and Wood.

* WHEN...Through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Showers and thunderstorms will continue to develop and slowly
move across portions of East Texas and Southeast Oklahoma through
the day on Friday. Additional rainfall amounts between 1" to 3"
will be possible. Some isolated higher totals can't be ruled out.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.
